verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is Delta Lake table history, which lets you query a table at a past point in time and roll it back. That shows past versions of data are kept, but nothing shows the user can set how long data is kept or delete it. Missing for 10: documented retention-period configuration, data deletion/purge controls (e.g., removing old table versions or permanently deleting records), retention or deletion of AI assistant and agent data, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
